name: Publish Artifact
description: Publish a file from the agent's home directory as durable, versioned evidence — into the live Front of House conversation as a card, or from a background run with no conversation at all. Images render as cards, PDFs open in a viewer, HTML pages open in a sandboxed live preview (CDN scripts, styles and fonts allowed), and any other file — markdown, CSV, JSON, code, text, audio, video — opens in a matching viewer or as a download. Every publish returns a stable public share URL anyone can open without signing in. harnesst copies the bytes without sending them through model context; publishing the same name again updates the artifact in place as a new version.
